title: Women Now Earn Most College Degrees, And The Gap Is Growing
hook: Your lecture hall flipped, and the gap keeps widening every year.
closing: The flip happened, and it's still speeding up.
question: Did you finish college? Tell me below.

segments.say: Women now earn 58 percent of all college degrees, up sharply since 1970.
Since 1995, young women's college completion rate has climbed 22 points, far outpacing young men's.
Among adults in their late twenties and early thirties, 47 percent of women now hold a college degree, well ahead of men.
